title: The Legend of the Golden King
description: Timed 12fps mythological storytelling with audio-visual synchronization logic and character consistency.

scenes.visual_prompt: A giant, glowing golden egg cracking open amidst a cosmic void. Intense light spills out, taking the shape of a massive bird. Mythical Vedic art style, swirling nebulae, high-contrast gold and deep purple. Cinematic sparkles and divine particles.
scenes.motion_prompt: Extreme camera push-in (dolly-in) towards the central crack; high-speed particle expansion outward from the center; 12fps stepped flickering light intensity.
scenes.narration: Long before the oceans were calmed, a power was born that shook the heavens.

scenes.visual_prompt: Character Anchor: Lord Garuda with a fierce white eagle face, sharp golden beak, emerald eyes, and muscular human torso. He wears a sun-fire crown and serpent ornaments. Massive copper wings span the horizon. Mythical Vedic art style, bold ink outlines.
scenes.motion_prompt: Slow-motion sweeping crane shot from talons to face; subtle rhythmic chest breathing; moving serpent ornaments in 12fps cycles.
scenes.narration: Half-man, half-eagle, his body glowed with the brilliance of a thousand suns.

scenes.visual_prompt: Same character: Lord Garuda soaring upward carrying a massive mountain in one claw. He leaves the Earth behind, passing through halftone dot clouds. Epic scale, cinematic wide shot, rich Vedic textures, bold outlines.
scenes.motion_prompt: Dynamic tracking shot from behind; camera shakes as wings flap; clouds part with fluid simulation; background mountains shrink rapidly.
scenes.narration: He flew higher than any god dared, driven by a sacred vow to free his mother.

scenes.visual_prompt: Same character: Lord Garuda bowing before a radiant blue light of Lord Vishnu. The background is a golden cosmic mandala. Garuda’s wings are spread wide. High-contrast mythological fantasy, divine light rays.
scenes.motion_prompt: Slow-motion 360-degree orbital rotation around the characters; gentle floating particles; soft zoom-out to reveal the full mandala.
scenes.narration: Today, he is the king of birds, reminding us that with purpose, you become unstoppable.
